d: Short, shaggy silver-grey hair with long thin braids and a red ribbon is paired with wide, glowing crimson eyes and a youthful, adolescent face. The slender build is dressed in a cream-colored waistcoat over a blue patterned shirt, topped with a long, flowing red and black cloak featuring ornate folk-style embroidery and decorative tassels. Black trousers are tucked into knee-high black leather boots, while a small red embroidered pouch and a red-and-black flute are held as accessories.
